description: No reasonable and appropriate policies and procedures to comply with Security Rule standards.
applicability: This signal applies to: Covered entities and business associates Healthcare organizations with business associate relationships Group health plans and plan sponsors Organizations requiring HIPAA compliance documentation Vendor management and contract administration functions

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Assess whether the organization has documented policies and procedures addressing all required and applicable Security Rule standards and implementation specifications. Review policy inventory and governance processes to identify gaps in coverage. Verify that policies are reasonable and appropriate given the organization's size, complexity, and technical infrastructure as required by the scalability principle.
